name: Religion and state
description: The relationship between religious institutions and the state.

laws.name: Strict secularism
laws.description: Religion is kept out of public institutions by law.

laws.name: Pluralist secularism
laws.description: No state religion; religions are treated equally and may cooperate with the state.

laws.name: Official religion
laws.description: A state church or recognised official religion, with freedom of worship for others.

laws.name: Partial religious law
laws.description: Religious law governs family and personal status, or is a main source of legislation.

laws.name: Theocratic law
laws.description: Religious authorities hold final legal and political authority.
